CreationSocieteSarl.description: The most common legal form in Madagascar, bringing together 2 to 100 partners (individuals or legal entities, all nationalities). CreationSocieteSarlu.title: Creation of SARLU (Limited Liability Company with a Single Partner)
CreationSocieteSarlu.description: The most common legal form in Madagascar, bringing together 1 to 100 partners (individuals or legal entities, all nationalities). No minimum capital is required, and each partner's liability is limited to their contribution. Ideal for a project supported by several people.

Domiciliation.title: An official address for your company
Domiciliation.description: Business domiciliation allows you to assign a registered office to your company without needing to physically carry out your activity there. This is the address that will appear on all your official documents: statutes, registration, invoices, and correspondence. Every company must necessarily have a registered office, which serves as the administrative and tax reference with the authorities.

why.first: A recognized professional address, separate from your personal home
why.second: Easier registration with the competent authorities
why.third: Centralized receipt of your mail and official documents
why.fourth: A more credible image with your clients and partners

MeetingRoom.title: Ready-to-use spaces for your meetings
MeetingRoom.description: Organizing a professional meeting often requires heavy logistics: booking a suitable venue, furniture, internet connection, audiovisual equipment... With meeting room rental, everything is already in place to start immediately, without constraints of layout or maintenance. Fully equipped rooms are made available to businesses and individuals to host meetings, client appointments, or work sessions, occasionally or on a regular basis.

ngo.eyebrow: Build your humanitarian and social commitment
ngo.title: NGO Creation (Non-Governmental Organization)
ngo.description: An NGO is a legal status distinct from an association, intended for groups with humanitarian, socio-economic, or development objectives, carrying out their activities professionally and on a permanent basis. Its recognition is more tightly regulated than that of an association: it requires official approval in addition to the statutes and declaration.

associationCreation.eyebrow: Give life to a collective project without profit motive
associationCreation.title: Association Creation
associationCreation.description: An association is a group of people united around a common objective, without profit motive. Its creation is based on drafting statutes and filing a declaration with the competent authorities, along with the list of founding members and the board.
